## Goal / acceptance criteria
Update `docs/i18n/STRINGS.md` and `docs/i18n/GLOSSARY_ES.md` for the user-visible strings changed in 3295547:
- practice banner `src/freemyid/wizard/dashboard.py` (~line 237): now "...looking for your listings, but no removal requests go out until you say so" (old STRINGS.md line ~52)
- setup screen `src/freemyid/wizard/ui.py` (~line 341): old "will not send anything to any site" (STRINGS.md line ~35)
- splash and installer text: "The first time can take up to a minute", and the 120 s "still starting… there is no need to click it again" text (`packaging/windows/splash_win.py`, `packaging/windows/freemyid.iss` FinishedLabel/[Run] Description) if STRINGS.md inventories them; add entries if it doesn't.
Exact file:line citations, translator notes (practice mode still searches), usted-form Spanish suggestions. Re-check that every other citation still resolves (WO-217 test). No product code.
